title: קציצות ברוטב
notes: The grouping label written vertically on the left edge next to the first bracket is only partly readable ('מרכיבים' + 'קציצות'); it is taken to mean the ingredients for the meatballs. The last line (פפריקה) runs close to the bottom edge of the scan; more lines may exist below the edge.
